answer: Ablation pricing makes each challenge word carry weight. Once a submission is graded, the ledger removes one randomly picked word and regrades the damaged text; payment is the drop in score. A genuine mechanism loses points because its pigment, ember or plume named a working part, not decoration. A farm rotating synonyms through a fixed shell loses nothing when any word is cut, so all its clones earn near zero. The attacker must write N answers in which every term is load-bearing, costing N real arguments rather than one template.
